name: Gallbladder
description: Pear-shaped sac on the undersurface of the liver (gallbladder fossa). Stores and concentrates bile. Parts: fundus, body, infundibulum (Hartmann pouch), neck. On CT: assess for stones (often hyperdense), wall thickening (>3 mm), pericholecystic fluid, masses, and porcelain gallbladder.
